Evelyn: morning — PR #412 updates the Console observability trace hook example to show how to enable KV prefix caching and annotate traces with cost/latency tags. Please review the python + rust snippets and the Console links. https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/412 :round_pushpin:

Sam T: thanks, adding to my queue. Quick ask — did we keep the example minimal or show autoscaling/caching tradeoffs?

Evelyn: kept minimal but added a short note about tradeoffs (batching vs latency). The code shows explicit cache lookup + fallback; thought it's clearer for users moving from the old tracehook example.

Rashmi: nit — the Console link in the doc 404s (console.redwood.com/docs/observability/traces -> returns 404). I think the canonical route is /console/observability/traces. I'll paste a fix in the PR.

Dave P: code lgtm for python. One tiny thing: the `trace.context.set_tag("cost_unit", ...)` call isn't in our SDK anymore; replace with `trace.add_metric("cost_units", ...)`.

Evelyn: good catch. Updated snippet. Also added a small rust snippet — keeping it intentionally short:

```python
# enable kv cache prefix + trace hook
from redwood import TraceHook, KVCache

cache = KVCache(prefix='user-session:')
hook = TraceHook(on_emit=lambda t: cache.prefetch(t.request_prefix))

with hook.trace('generate') as trace:
    trace.add_metric('tokens', len(response.tokens))
```

```rust
// prefetch pattern (pseudocode)
let mut cache = KVCacher::new(\"user-session:\");
trace.on_emit(|t| cache.prefetch(t.request_prefix()));
```

Luis: small thought — add a Console screenshot showing the cost/latency breakdown widget next to the trace view. Otherwise users miss the linkage.

Evelyn: agree. I captured a tiny screenshot (will upload to the PR). Also added a "migration note" for teams using tracehook v1.

Sam T: leaving a review now. Approving pending the `add_metric` rename and the fixed Console link.

deploy-bot: docs CI passed — linkcheck flagged one external link (old internal CDN) still 302 -> will need a redirect or updated URL.

Evelyn: thanks everyone — merging after Sam's approval and Rashmi's link patch. I'll follow up with the screenshot upload and an announcement in #product-docs when live. :tada:
